evidence_status: posthoc scope-definition feasibility audit using only previously collected public metadata; not an efficacy result, trained rule, or confirmation experiment

scope.status: new exploratory structural definition; it is not an amendment to, or a rescue of, the full-length Stage107 protocol
scope.reason_for_rescoping: The Stage107 public metadata show that the former full-length reference-coverage threshold systematically excludes catalytic-domain structures. Entity sequence coverage, rather than full-length reference coverage, is the relevant integrity check within this explicitly redefined structural scope.

provisional_reference.selection_status: metadata-only provisional reference; coordinate work remains locked

pool_gate.selection_rule_if_pool_gate_passes: Choose the lowest-resolution wild-type metadata-eligible entry, breaking ties by PDB identifier. This rule is recorded only for feasibility; it does not authorize coordinate download in this stage.
pool_gate.decision_rule: If fewer than 16 metadata-eligible catalytic-domain structures are available, record No-Go. Do not lower the pool threshold after observing the candidate count; a future smaller-pool project would require a separate protocol and cannot be called a confirmation of the 16-receptor experiment.

decision.next_action: Stop PARP1 under the frozen 16-receptor protocol. A future smaller-pool study requires a separately reviewed protocol and is not a confirmation of this branch.
